scope: Compare exactly three label-blind, path-only original Go helpers on experiment46's 4456 eligible training representatives. No fitting, new validation rankings, final outcomes, model invocation, activation, weights or source body acquisition. Existing failed experiment46 remains authoritative.
selection: Revalidate experiment46 source/cost/input hashes and numeric-row seal offline. Select train roles only from the resulting private Costs. Recompute baseline and old helper costs byte-for-byte before comparing new helpers. Keep all7335 original train members in coverage with prior exclusion reasons; do not replace requests, use validation outcomes to choose a helper, or count repeats as requests.

variants.rule: Use unchanged identifier NormalizeText for full path/query BM25; retain only strictly positive auxiliary scores, first64 in stable rank order, then baseline-first partial interleave.

For full paths and basenames independently, retain lower-case joined identifiers alongside unchanged split identifiers. Rank both BM25 fields against the same joined-plus-split full query. Sum 1/(60+one-based-rank) only for strictly positive field scores. Fixed equal field weights; positive fused evidence first64, catalog-index ties; baseline-first partial interleave.

Read complete query tokens consisting of Unicode letters/digits and underscore,dot,hyphen,slash. Require slash or dot and an exact case-sensitive full-path or slash-boundary suffix match against the catalog. Sort evidence by more matched path segments, then more token bytes, then catalog index; deduplicate and keep64. No exact evidence yields unchanged baseline. This hypothesis is kept separate from BM25 fusion.

bounds: Complete UTF-8 queries<=128KiB, unique canonical paths<=100000 and16MiB, each aligned text catalog<=16MiB. Each new textual helper field preflights<=262144 lexical tokens and index vocabulary<=131072. Explicit anchors are sorted/compacted, and unique-anchor count times path count must be<=8000000 before any suffix comparisons; excess falls back with no partial hints. Fail closed to baseline with a recorded reason on auxiliary bounds/errors, rather than truncating input or dropping a task. Caller-owned arrays, immutable indexes, sequential worker, no global locks.
metrics: Report training-only baseline, legacy control and each fixed helper: pages20 to first mapped target, Hit1/10/100, All10, per-repository and equal-repository macro; wins/losses/ties, sum positive gains, sum negative gains, optimistic oracle positive-page-gain divided by baseline pages, real auxiliary attempts/fallbacks/coverage. Record a deterministic private ranking/evidence digest without publishing task IDs, paths, queries, labels or coefficients. Oracle knows gold and is not deployable.
interpretation: The unchanged experiment46 advancement gate requires>=5percent page reduction plus its quality/call/repository constraints. Training-only oracle headroom>=5percent is only a necessary screen; below5percent stops that helper before claim fitting. Do not lower the5percent gate, choose favorable seeds or manufacture labels. Above5percent requires a separately precommitted fitting/selection experiment and untouched final confirmation; no new winner is chosen from validation in this screen.
resources: Measure sequential isolated full offline screen wall/user/system/maxRSS; target<=256MiB and report exceedance. Run exact offline replay and meaningful error/permutation/label-independence/race tests. Use a public original fixture for optional Go heap pprof; do not equate Go heap with total RSS or infer GPU/LLM savings.
references: Independent implementation informed by pinned Apache2 laya-codex580bc73c2ed95fd319db93ef725f30bf35047428 identifier/retriever concepts and original2009 RRF formula.
